title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page does not belong to the divided-power de Rham notes around it. It is a typed page (page 52, Exposé IX) of Grothendieck's 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, §5.1, apparently a reused or misfiled sheet. Handwriting from the reverse side shows through, and the archive stamp reads 370.

Setting: S is the spectrum of a complete discrete valuation ring, with S_n = Spec(R/m^{n+1}). A is the Néron model of an abelian variety A_K, and A^o is its identity component. T is the maximal torus of the special fibre A^o_s; it lifts uniquely to a formal torus \hat T inside the formal completion \hat A^o, with truncations T_n over S_n.

Step 1. Formal completion along the special fibre gives an equivalence between finite S-schemes and finite formal S-schemes (cited as EGA III 4.8). So a finite S-scheme can be identified with its formal completion.

Step 2. Under this identification, the 'fixed (finite) part' of the quasi-finite flat group ℓ^ν A^o is the ℓ^ν-torsion of the formal group \hat A^o (5.1.4). Equivalently, as projective systems, T_ℓ(A^o)^f = T_ℓ(\hat A^o) (5.1.5).

Step 3. The toric part is defined as the sub-pro-Barsotti–Tate group T_ℓ(\hat T) ⊂ T_ℓ(\hat A^o) = T_ℓ(A^o)^f (5.1.6).

Step 4. Concretely, T_ℓ(A^o)^t is the system (ℓ^ν \hat T)_ν (5.1.7). Each ℓ^ν \hat T is a finite flat S-group, the inductive limit of the S_n-groups ℓ^ν(T_n) (5.1.8); equivalently, its affine algebra is the projective limit of their affine algebras. Its reduction to S_n is T_ℓ(T_n) (5.1.9).

Purpose: to define the toric and fixed parts of the Tate module (or Barsotti–Tate group) in a way that also works for ℓ = p. This feeds the orthogonality theorem and the semistable reduction criterion of SGA 7 IX.
errors: No mathematical errors visible. The precise EGA III citation (4.8) could not be verified from memory but is plausibly the passage on formal finite schemes and the existence theorem.
Archival note: the page is misfiled within cote 136. It is a typescript page of SGA 7 Exposé IX, not part of the divided-power de Rham notes on the neighbouring pages.

ideas.what: Identifying finite S-schemes with finite formal S-schemes over a complete DVR, and using this to describe the finite (fixed) part of ℓ^ν A^o as ℓ^ν of the formal completion
ideas.modern_name: Finite part of quasi-finite group schemes; formal GAGA for finite schemes

ideas.what: Toric part of the Tate module / Barsotti–Tate group, defined through the lifted formal torus \hat T
ideas.modern_name: Toric part of the p-divisible group of a Néron model; filtration T_ℓ^t ⊂ T_ℓ^f ⊂ T_ℓ

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typed page from the published SGA 7 Exposé IX §5.1, filed by mistake among the divided-power de Rham notes. Its content is fully published and well known. The only notable point is archival: the misfiling.
transcription_corrections: Header reads '- 52 -' and 'IX': this is page 52 of SGA 7 Exposé IX typescript, unrelated to the surrounding manuscript.
The stamp '370' at the bottom and the bleed-through handwriting on the lower half are archival or reverse-side artifacts, not part of the text.
